d: Courtyard with a practicable staircase on one side and on the other door that leads to the garden. Don Tammaro that falls down the stairs chased by woman Rosa with a stick, Emilia, Lauretta and Calandrino, that hold her. Hippolytus that comes and not seen listens.
Donna Rosa, Emilia, Lauretta and Ippolito.
Donna Rosa, Emilia and Ippolito.
Lonely retreat with some fountains. Don Tammaro and Calandrino.
Don Tammaro, Calandrino who immediately returns, and then master Antonio and Cilla.
Don Tammaro and Master Antonio.
Master Antonio alone, then woman Rosa, Emilia, Lauretta and Ippolito dressed in Greek.
Donna Rosa, Emilia, Lauretta, Ippolito and then Don Tammaro.
Donna Rosa and Don Tammaro.
Hippolyte and sayings.
Don Tammaro solo, indi Cilla and Calandrino and then master Antonio.
Cilla and Calandrino.

Underground, or either cellar, destined for the Socrates school. At the bottom of it, rustic practicable staircase, for which it ascends to a passetto, which ends at the top with a small door similarly practicable. On one side of the scene another door, from which for a few steps it descends to the floor: also practicable. Donna Rosa, Lauretta and Ippolito; then Emilia from the door near the piano, and then Don Tammaro, dressed as a philosopher in the ancient manner followed by master Antonio and four of his disciples, dressed for the use of the shepherds of Basilicata, and finally Cilla and Calandrino.
Room. Lauretta, Cilla and Calandrino.
Single calandrino, then woman Rosa and Ippolito.
Donna Rosa, Don Tammaro and Calandrino.
Donna Rosa, Don Tammaro, Indi Emilia, Lauretta and Calandrino returning, Ippolito on one side and Master Antonio on the other.
Donna Rosa, Emilia, Lauretta, Ippolito, master Antonio and Calandrino.
Donna Rosa, Emilia and then Ippolito who returns with Lauretta and Calandrino.
Lauretta, Calandrino and immediately Don Tammaro and Master Antonio.
Lauretta and Master Antonio.

Horrid cave, in which few lists of light are introduced from some opening made by time in the vault of it. Half of its façade contains a rustic wall with large door of old tables, stopped by a lock. The other half of the façade is formed by arches cut by the chisel in the stone. Don Tammaro with harp, Calandrino and choir of Furie.

A thunder comes out preceded by a flash of very white light and fills the scene with endless flying stars: the door of the prospect opens wide and over a small machine, formed like a car, you will find seated woman Rosa from the shadow of Cicilia, adorned with flowers, and Ippolito bizarrely dressed as a demon. Don Tammaro, suddenly show, struck by strong fear, falls on his knees and shakes. Donna Rosa, Ippolito and said.
Donna Rosa, Emilia, then Lauretta is said.
Calandrino and sayings.
Donna Rosa, Lauretta, Emilia that stays behind, Ippolito and then Calandrino, said.
Master Antonio, who carries with serious step the cup with poison, accompanied by two clothes by Judges of Athens and sayings, who remain in different tragic situations.
Anticamera with lights. Emilia and Ippolito.
Noble room. Don Tammaro sleeping on a sofa with Turkish pavilion, woman Rosa, Lauretta and Calandrino.
Cilla, Master Antonio and sayings.
Lauretta, Cilla, Master Antonio and Calandrino.
Tammaro and Rosa.
Everyone.
